decision.title: Verification in proportion; agent prompts in the repository (owner)
decision.summary: A packet verifies in proportion (the debug preset, the tests and conformance sets it affects, clean lint for its files), full runs and fuzzing move to the owner's machine, and agent prompts live in docs/agents/.

body.p: on the owner's word: re-running all builds and fuzzing everything takes too long here; the owner will provision a machine for that. Amends the done-when of the packet procedure ('s local checks).

item.p: A packet builds the debug preset (Clang, ASan and UBSan, -Werror), runs the unit and CLI tests it touches, keeps clang-tidy and the call-cycle check clean for its files, and runs the conformance test sets it affects with no fewer passes. debug-gcc and wasm only when a change is platform-sensitive or may grow sxml.wasm noticeably.

Full suite runs, all presets, the full lint and fuzzing move to the owner's machine. Gate boxes that need them stay open, marked "deferred to the owner's machine ()"; docs/CONFORMANCE.md is regenerated only from full runs.
The agent prompts live in docs/agents/ (BRIEF.md, PACKET.md, and QUEUE.md for the running and next work), so any session can continue the work; commit messages carry the reasons and the numbers.
The user-facing CLI reference is apps/sxml/README.md; docs/CLI.md keeps the design rules ().
